channel.description: Recent content in October 2026 Curations on Junho Lee

item.title: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation via Node Perturbation
item.description: Q Labs’ Dust paper trains Transformer language models using forward-only activation noise perturbation, trading extra FLOPs for lower memory bandwidth and state overhead.

item.title: Entire and Trails: Former GitHub CEO's AI-Native Alternative to Pull Requests
item.description: Founded by former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke, Entire replaces traditional pull requests with AI-scored Trails, codebase graphs that cut token use by 71%, and integrated CI.

item.title: AI Coding Agent Harness Complexity vs. Cost Efficiency
item.description: A Shandong University and UC Berkeley study finds complex agent harnesses rarely beat minimal ones on SWE-bench accuracy while raising costs up to 3x.

item.title: Putting Shell Scripts in the macOS Menu Bar with SwiftBar
item.description: Learn how SwiftBar turns standard shell script output into live macOS menu bar items and dropdown menus for local dev server checks and project links.

item.title: taste-skill vs. AI Design Skills: Picking the Right Web Design Skill
item.description: A side-by-side comparison of taste-skill and AI Design Skills across visual direction, landing-page copywriting, browser inspection, and motion demos.

item.title: Switching Claude Code Setups by Task with the Ultra Config Mod
item.description: Ultra Config bundles model, reasoning effort, output style, and permission rules into five Claude Code profiles with diff previews, undo support, and clear scope limits.

item.title: Pele: A Fast, Lightweight Library for Rendering Mermaid Diagrams to SVG
item.description: Pele renders Mermaid syntax into SVG with zero runtime dependencies, CSS variable theming, and a compact bundle size - here is how it compares to Mermaid.js.

item.title: Handy: Dictating AI Prompts Directly at Your Cursor on macOS
item.description: Handy is a free open-source macOS speech-to-text app that inserts dictated text right at the cursor, using Whisper Large v3 locally while keeping data boundaries clear.

item.title: Tracking Claude Code Multi-Session Progress in Real Time with deadhd
item.description: The deadhd plugin visualizes Claude Code step checklists, hook-driven session states, and multi-session progress across terminal bands and browser views.

item.title: 100 Tasks Delegated to AI Browser Aside: From Coffee Orders to Mixpanel
item.description: Jonghun Seo documented 100 real tasks run in the AI browser Aside across 10 categories, covering scheduled routines, Mixpanel debugging, Mac terminal jobs, and current limits.

item.title: Codex Update Challenge Week 1 Review: 500K Context and Faster Throughput
item.description: A week-one review of the Codex Update Challenge covering the 500K default context window, 50 TPS speed boost, free Auto-review, and live steering.

item.title: Filee: A Free Local Converter Supporting 180 File Formats on Your PC
item.description: Filee is a free open-source desktop converter that handles 180 file formats locally via drag-and-drop and CLI folder watching without cloud uploads.

item.title: Showreel: Automating Korean Motion Graphics with a Claude Code Skill
item.description: Showreel is a Claude Code agent skill that turns a single prompt into Korean motion graphics with narration, music, deterministic HTML rendering, and automated QA.

item.title: Analyzing REA: AI Agent-Driven Reverse Engineering and Code Recovery
item.description: Open-source tool REA connects AI agents via MCP to inspect binaries and app internals locally, recovering byte-accurate C source code.

item.title: Google AI Edge Foresight: A Free On-Device AI Meeting Notes App for Mac
item.description: Google’s experimental Mac app AI Edge Foresight transcribes meetings, expands notes, and searches local documents entirely on-device using EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4.

item.title: Scaling Execution with AI Agents and the Role of Specialists
item.description: AI agents let individuals scale execution through token investment and feedback loops, making clear planning and deep specialist review the real differentiators.

item.title: Using Pride as a Loop Goal: An Experiment Against Metric Rubrics
item.description: An experimental design testing whether Boris Cherny’s “iterate till you’re proud of it” prompt outperforms explicit evaluation rubrics in agent loops.

item.title: What an AI-Native Team Leaves in Its Repo: Inside DeepSeek Harness
item.description: An analysis of the DeepSeek Harness repository covering AGENTS.md completion rules, status-based Agent Notes folders, and shared team skills.

item.title: Why Is the AI Industry Not Panicking About DeepSeek 4.1 Flash?
item.description: A developer’s one-month review of DeepSeek 4.1 Flash across 12 projects, comparing per-task costs against Opus 5.5 and examining its 437x KV cache reduction.

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: On-Device Multimodal Search in One Vector Space
item.description: Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2 maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a shared 768-dimensional space with optional encoders for on-device search.

item.title: Running Multiple AI Coding Agents as One Team with OpenRig
item.description: OpenRig lets developers define multiple AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex in YAML and coordinate them as a persistent team.

item.title: Quail: High-Throughput AI-SQL Engine Co-Optimizing Query Plans and LLMs
item.description: Quail jointly optimizes SQL execution plans and LLM KV cache reuse, beating vLLM on 27 of 29 AI-SQL benchmark queries with a 1.84x geometric mean speedup.

item.title: diagram-design: Zero-Dependency Editorial HTML/SVG Diagrams for Agents
item.description: The diagram-design agent skill generates self-contained editorial HTML and SVG diagrams across 42 layouts for Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot without JS or build steps.

item.title: Using the ASD-STE100 Aerospace Standard for Clearer LLM Responses
item.description: Andrej Karpathy highlighted ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English as a sharper alternative to ELI5 prompts for stripping ambiguity out of LLM explanations.

item.title: Claude & Codex Skill Guidebook: 56 Curated Agent Skills by Role
item.description: A free Korean WikiDocs guidebook curating 56 GitHub agent skills for Claude Code and Codex, organized with role-based roadmaps, fit tables, and weekly radar updates.

item.title: claude.dev: Anthropic's Engineering Blog for Building with Claude
item.description: Anthropic launched claude.dev as an engineering blog sharing internal lessons on Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 task costs, Claude Code skills, and context engineering.

item.title: Hands-On with Dots: Three Strengths and One Major Workflow Catch
item.description: A hands-on review of the Dots agent covers proactive follow-ups, zero-config setup, and local CLI orchestration, plus its single-thread catch.

item.title: OpenAI's Re-Recorded Dots Demo: Travel Booking to Slack Triage
item.description: After keynote Wi-Fi hiccups, OpenAI Developers shared a clean replay of the Dots agent handling policy-compliant travel, Slack-to-Linear triage, and unread messages.

item.title: Thursday: Open-Source Voice Assistant Backed by Background AI Bots
item.description: Thursday separates live voice conversation on GPT-Live 1 from background bots that run browser, shell, and file tasks asynchronously on your local machine.

item.title: Multi-Stage Prototyping Workflow for Designing Websites with Coding Agents
item.description: How the Railcode team generated 4-10 broad variations per concept, locked a Visual Anchor in single-file HTML, and curated agent outputs into a distinctive website.

item.title: Semantica: Knowledge Graph Tracking for AI Decisions and Provenance
item.description: Semantica records data facts and AI decisions as knowledge graph nodes with W3C PROV-O export and rule-based reasoning, alongside current Rete engine limitations.

item.title: Google RRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for AI Agent Harnesses
item.description: Google Research’s Apache 2.0 RRSI framework freezes LLM weights and recursively optimizes agent harnesses via dual regularization and Git worktrees.
